descriptions.en: DSH Mobile Host pairing with a loopback gateway, public endpoint discovery, WebRTC Direct, and encrypted tunnel fallback.
descriptions.zh: DSH Mobile Host 配对插件，提供回环网关、公网端点发现、WebRTC Direct 和加密隧道回退。

notice.en: This release uses @dsh-mobile/e2e-tunnel v0.1.6. Existing device keys remain on the Host; QR, Direct, and Relay checks must be run against the paired mobile app.
notice.zh: 此版本使用 @dsh-mobile/e2e-tunnel v0.1.6。Host 上的设备密钥会保留；二维码、Direct 和 Relay 检查需与已配对手机一起执行。
